test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A+ B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is R related to T if ‘Q ÷ R + P – S ÷ T’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother 
 Wife 
 Father 
 
 

 

Given: Q ÷ R + P – S ÷ T

It means: Q is the father of R, R is the mother of P, P is the brother of S and S is the father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f0d45bce766d519122a7c461cf6628b35aa8da49e6e9bc2fb0be87fbf0c1a83.png] 

So, R is the 'Father's mother' of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
